show.description: When a genius mechanic secretly known as a legendary racer  saves a garage from a gangster through a deadly race, he later joins an electric car company where the arrogant new CEO humiliates and fires him. As rival companies battle to recruit him and a fake genius rises inside the company, he prepares to prove that real talent cannot be replaced.
